# Keep draft expiry announcements after switching views

## What & Why
Draft expiry is managed at the router level, so a user can leave the draft's view before the deadline and return after recovery has expired. Coverage should confirm that returning to either view still presents the correct no-longer-available announcement instead of silently dropping the feedback.

## Done looks like
- An expired answer draft announces that it is no longer available after navigating away and back.
- An expired opportunity draft does the same.
- No recovery form opens from either expired draft.

## Relevant files
- artifacts/escape-hatch/src/App.tsx
- artifacts/escape-hatch/tests/persistence.spec.ts
